description.zh:
执行时间，取值：
* **Immediately**：立即执行，默认值。
* **MaintainTime**：在可维护时间段执行。

> 您可以调用[ModifyInstanceMaintainTime](~~473775~~)接口修改实例的可维护时间段。
description.en:
The time when you want to delete the expired keys. Default value: Immediately. Valid values:

*   **Immediately**: deletes the keys immediately.
*   **MaintainTime**: deletes the keys during the maintenance window.

>  You can call the [ModifyInstanceMaintainTime](~~473775~~) operation to modify the maintenance window of an instance.

descriptions.zh:
该API对应的控制台操作请参见[清除数据](~~43881~~)。

> 过期key清除后不可恢复，请谨慎使用该接口。
descriptions.en:
For more information about how to clear the expired keys in the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) console, see [Clear data](~~43881~~).

>  Expired keys cannot be recovered after they are deleted. Exercise caution when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore flush-expire-keys --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --effective-time Immediately --region cn-hangzhou
